leak_check:
THREE DEFECTS. The first is the one the prior run flagged and is worse than reported; the second is new and is the most serious; the third is in the instrument, not the corpus.

(1) NON-STRIPPED FIELDS CARRY THE PRICED CONTENT — and they carry 30 of the 48 rows, not a handful. I classified every priced row by the corpus field its corpus_ref points at: primitives 24, empirical_inputs 18, constants 6, known_disconnects 5, alternative_formulations 2, observables 1. Only empirical_inputs and constants were stripped. So exactly half the inventory is drawn from `primitives`, which was fully visible to every kernel computer.

This is qualitatively worse than the known_connections issue because of HOW the primitives field is phrased. It is not physics content that happens to overlap; it is the audit's own typing verdict, in priced vocabulary. Verbatim from the corpus:
- nonequilibrium/primitives/1: "The choice of projection operator -- which variables count as slow/relevant -- is a declared input of the Mori-Zwanzig construction, not an output of it"
- nonequilibrium/primitives/0: "Local equilibrium ... is a primitive ... assumed rather than derived"
- open_quantum/primitives/0: "The system-environment tensor split and the interaction Hamiltonian are declared inputs of every open-system construction, not derived objects"
- statistical_mechanics/primitives/0: "A probability measure over microstates ... is a primitive of the statistical description, not derived from the microdynamics"

And the kernel computers quote these back as their justification. statistical-relaxation's kernel element "The choice of projector: which variables count as slow" has as its entire why_not_erased a verbatim quotation of nonequilibrium/primitives/1. Its "probability measure over microstates" element quotes statistical_mechanics/primitives/0 verbatim ("The brief lists this as a PRIMITIVE: ..."). open-quantum's "declared system-environment tensor factorization" element says "The briefs' primitives entry records these as declared inputs of every open-system construction, not derived objects." These are not independent derivations; they are the audit's typing handed back.

(2) THE KNOWN_CONNECTIONS EDGE, CONFIRMED, PLUS FOUR MORE FIELDS. statistical_mechanics/known_connections/1 reads "arrow-of-time REQUIRES boundary condition -- INPUT (the past hypothesis), origin UNRESOLVED". The statistical-relaxation computer quotes it verbatim as evidence for its past-hypothesis kernel element. I checked further: the string "low-entropy" appears in that domain's primitives[0], derived_objects[2], known_disconnects[1] and open_problems[0] as well — four additional non-stripped fields. Blinding on the past-hypothesis row was effectively zero. Similarly statistical_mechanics/known_disconnects/0 states in explicit priced vocabulary "Dynamics-intrinsic structure does NOT fix the direction of relaxation", which is the content of priced row 47; and open_quantum/known_disconnects/1 carries "decoherence observables alone do not determine branch weights ... alpha in {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}", reproducing even the parenthetical of priced row 35.

(3) NO HARD LEAK OF THE STRIPPED FIELDS THEMSELVES — I verified this rather than assuming it. Every measured value the kernel files cite is reachable from a non-stripped field: n_s = 0.965±0.004 sits in empirical_inputs[1] AND symmetries[0]; T_CMB = 2.72548 in constants[0] AND observables[0]; D/H = 2.527e-5 in phenomena[3] and observables[0]; alpha = -0.0127(3), A+/A- = 1.053(2), 8.6e-11, e*=e/3, phi=pi/3 all in phenomena/observables; Micadei in phenomena[3]; MICROSCOPE in symmetries[1]; FIRAS |mu|<9e-5 in phenomena[2]. The "13 flavour parameters" tally appears in quantum_field_theory_eft/domain_of_validity[0], not only in the stripped empirical_inputs — so the target number was visible, though the qft computer re-derived it independently from orbit dimensions (36-26=10, 18-15=3) and said so. No kernel file shows knowledge of a priced-input LIST, of K-U, of the 48-row table, or of this phase's question. The method_notes are internally consistent with genuine blinding on those points, and all six show real independent work (external verification of Ocneanu rigidity, Chayes-Chayes-Fisher-Spencer scope, Albert-Jiang capacity counts, Wald's Bianchi-IX threshold, the corrected 41/10pi coefficient, Pendleton-Ross vs Hill).

(4) THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF LEAKED THE CATEGORY. This is not a corpus defect and it is the deepest one. All six computers refer to an "undetermined-by-the-flow" kernel category that their prompt supplied: condensed-matter — "Listed as kernel in the 'undetermined by the flow' sense the task allows"; open-quantum — "This is the task's 'undetermined-by-the-flow' category in its exact form"; qft — "an instance of 'undetermined-by-the-flow', not of 'preserved-through-the-flow'"; statistical-relaxation — "the archetype in this domain of structure undetermined by the flow"; cosmology — "genuinely undetermined-by-the-flow data". "Information the description's own dynamics does not determine, and which must therefore be supplied from outside" is not merely correlated with "priced input" — it is a definition of it. The blinded computers were never told the priced list exists, but they were handed a kernel category co-extensive with it. Any correspondence established through that category is analytic, not empirical.

DISCOUNT APPLIED. I marked NO on every row whose only match runs through a verbatim non-stripped restatement or through the pure "parameter of the contraction / undetermined by the flow" move with no independent mathematical argument: rows 13 (past hypothesis), 28 (S-E split + H_int), 31 and 47 (relaxation direction), 32 (local equilibrium), 33 (Mori-Zwanzig projector), 46 (probability measure). That is 7 rows, all of them among K-U's own showcase instances. Two rows (35 branch weights, 45 AQFT net assignment) I scored YES despite visible content, because the kernel element rests on an independent theorem — the Schur-multiplier unit-diagonal argument and Buchholz-D'Antoni-Fredenhagen universality respectively — that does real work the restatement could not have supplied. I flag both as contamination-suspect in their notes.

WHERE THE BOUNDARY FALLS — six places contraction does not reach:

1. HOW MANY. The decisive limit. Kernel dimension is set by structure independent of the contraction: the orbit geometry of the redundancy group (13 in flavor), the dimension of the null space of the linearized collision operator (d+2, or infinite for integrable systems under generalized hydrodynamics), the number of relevant operators at the fixed point, the count of conserved charges. The sweep exhibits a maximal contraction with a large kernel (flavor: 72% erased, 13 left) and a maximal contraction with a tiny kernel (no-hair: infinite-dimensional erasure, 2 numbers left). K-U's clause "small exactly because the available contractions have small joint kernel" has no support and one clean counterexample.

2. ANYTHING UPSTREAM OF THE MAP. Framework primitives that PARAMETRIZE a contraction rather than being acted on by it: the system-environment split and H_int, the Mori-Zwanzig projector, the macro-partition, the local-equilibrium declaration, the probability measure over microstates, the Hilbert-space and tensor-composition structure, locality. Membership here is analytic — "a map cannot erase what indexes it" is true of every map whatsoever — and these are also exactly the rows where the corpus leaked. Two defects coinciding on one class is not a coincidence: the class is where the claim was always going to be empty.

3. INVERTIBLE REGIMES. Where the dynamics is a group, nothing is erased and "kernel" is vacuously everything: classical Cauchy data, the Gleason and Solèr premises, the operational-reconstruction axioms, the CDT foliation. K-U is untestable there. This is C-I's narrowed domain, and its boundary is the same boundary.

4. THE PAST HYPOTHESIS AND THE DIRECTION OF TIME. Not a fit, and the sweep says so in the strongest terms it produced: "every contraction in this list acts only toward the future. None of them constrains, supplies, or explains the initial condition -- a many-to-one forward map makes postdiction of initial data strictly impossible ... attractor behavior is the specific reason it cannot be addressed from within the flow." K-U's own birth flag ("fits by construction; suspicious for that very reason") is vindicated, and K-I's predicted kill (a boundary condition, not a coupling, that K-I cannot type) lands exactly where K-I predicted it would.

5. THE DERIVED BULK OF THE KERNEL. Nine-tenths of the computed kernel is predicted content — exponents, anomaly coefficients, quantization conditions, sum rules, consistency relations, positivity cones, the a-theorem monotone. This is where a description's PREDICTIVE power lives, and it is unpriced for that reason. The correspondence therefore runs one way only: priced is contained in kernel, as the free-coordinate part, never equal to it.

6. VALUES, EVEN WHERE THE OBJECT IS MATCHED. Even the sweep's cleanest hit is structural rather than numerical: the Chern-integer kernel explains why R_K is quantized and material-independent to 8.6e-11, not why it equals h/e^2 for the h and e we have. The same holds throughout class B — the contraction names the coordinates and fixes none of them.

ONE-SENTENCE FORM: contraction explains which supplied information is expressible and why microscopic detail is not priced — the erasure side is clean, forced, and well-verified — but it does not explain the size of what remains, does not reach the primitives that define the map, is vacuous where dynamics is invertible, and is silent on the initial condition; so the mechanism K-U identified is real and the smallness it was built to explain remains unexplained.
